about: Scorpia's cave under the Scorpion Pit (Wilderness step W4.4): Scorpia and her 27 offspring. Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live), the same as the OSRS Wiki's LocLines. Her guardians come only in her fight (Scorpia.kt). Every wander range is guessed until recorded.
